project.name: 矩阵模块甘特图设计稿

intentProfile.routingReason: 用户希望看到矩阵模块的设计稿;TRAE Work 设计系统作为风格约束源,走 Library-bound 严格路径

styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: Brand accent #4b3fe3 (--bg-brand); surfaces #ffffff / #f5f5f5 / #e5e5e5; overlays rgba(115,115,115,0.08~0.2); status success #15a877, error #e8463a, alert #fea900, warning #e27900; brand color scarce — only for primary action and meaningful status accents
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: Container radius --radius-8; card/dialog radius --radius-12; borders 1px neutral; no drop shadows unless component defines them; depth via surface tint + overlay ladder
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: SF Pro Text + PingFang SC; body-base 14px/20px -0.02em; body-md 12px/18px; body-sm 11px/16px; heading-sm 16px/24px 600; mono JetBrains Mono for numbers/code; metric Inter for large KPI
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: Page padding --spacer-32 desktop; gaps --spacer-16 related cards, --spacer-24 card groups, --spacer-32 sections; tight row internals --spacer-4/6/8
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: ds-btn / ds-card / ds-tag / ds-avatar / ds-table / ds-tabs / ds-input / ds-menu; compose from .ds-* primitives; one brand CTA per view; neutral overlays for selection; row dividers for tables
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: Light mode only; surface ladder base-default > base-secondary > base-tertiary > overlay-l1..l4; no nested bordered containers; avoid decorative shadows
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: Local SVG icons 16px default, 14px dense, 24px anchor; currentColor masks in token-colored controls; no external icon libs
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: 120ms hover, 200ms state change, 300ms max reveal; opacity + <=4px translate; no layout shift on state change; prefers-reduced-motion respected

iconAssets.coloringRule: currentColor by default; override with Library token when needed
